note: Rehearsal with the parts shared round: American (Rob), British/Scottish (Mi'kael) and Indian English (Panshul) idiom, including lakh and crore

segments.speaker: Rob
segments.say: alright y'all, so back in the day three buddies are holed up at a denny's, i mean we're talking grand slam breakfast and free refills, and they figure, hey, how come only the fat cats get to have three d graphics. let's put that puppy in every pc in america, and the gamers can pick up the tab.

segments.speaker: Mi'kael
segments.say: and then they nearly made a pig's ear of it. the first thing off the line was pure mince, practically all of them got sent back, and they were skint, i mean properly on their uppers. had sega not bunged them five million out of the goodness of its heart they'd have gone bust. it was the riva that got them out the mire.

segments.speaker: Panshul
segments.say: then in ninety nine itself they brought out the first gpu, and this name also they only have given. the xbox team was so impressed that they paid twenty crore dollars in advance. it was a very happening gaming company, forbes also felicitated them. any other management would have relaxed there only, isn't it.

segments.speaker: Rob
segments.say: but nope, they swung for the fences. so a regular processor's like one hotshot quarterback running every play himself, one after another. a gpu's like having ten thousand guys on the field and everybody moves on the snap. and cuda's the playbook, and they handed that playbook out to anybody who wanted it, no strings attached, on the house.

segments.speaker: Mi'kael
segments.say: the city was having none of it. the suits were up in arms, half a billion a year down the drain on a thing no punter had asked for. shares went through the floor in two thousand and eight, turnover was flat as a pancake, and some stroppy fund pitched up later to give them a right earful. they just kept calm and cracked on.

segments.speaker: Panshul
segments.say: and see, finally it clicked. one boy was doing his studies in toronto, he took two gaming cards and gave the image recognition examination, and he topped it, and not by one or two marks, by more than ten. the rest were making twenty six percent mistakes, he was making fifteen. from then onwards the whole ai fraternity shifted to this platform.

segments.speaker: Panshul
segments.say: now the biggest strength is the software, and i will tell you how. sixty lakh developers are using it. more than one thousand libraries are there, totally free of cost, and for nearly twenty years they've been improving them. amd woke up in twenty sixteen. it's like how once your entire joint family is on iphone, who will go back to android.

segments.speaker: Mi'kael
segments.say: and even if you'd a cracking design in your back pocket, you'd be stuck, because there's only the one shop in town, tsmc over in taiwan, and it's chock a block. the fiddly bit's the packaging, that's where the queue is, and nvidia have bagsied around sixty percent of it already. you'd be waiting till the cows come home.

segments.speaker: Rob
segments.say: so has anybody closed the gap. google's in the ballpark, they've been at it since twenty fifteen and they've dropped some serious coin. the other big dogs, amazon, meta, microsoft, they've all got skin in the game. but at the end of the day they're all still in line at nvidia's window with their wallets open. that's a home run in my book.

segments.speaker: Mi'kael
segments.say: for your average joe it's already taking the faff out of the day job. folk who write reports are done in a bit over half the time and it's a better read. the new start on the help desk is sorting a third more calls. and afore you say it'll put us on the dole, they said that about the hole in the wall, and the banks ended up hiring more tellers.

segments.speaker: Panshul
segments.say: kindly have a look at this figure. this much revenue has come in three months only, till the twenty fifth of october. i am not telling you the annual number, just the one quarter. preliminary it is, but still, mind boggling.

segments.speaker: Panshul
segments.say: and you people must be thinking, it'll be very costly no. actually not. if you compare on the earnings expected this financial year with the other four chip majors, this one's coming cheapest. after the ceo put in his papers the share has corrected, but the profit estimates have not budged even one bit. so it is value for money only.

segments.speaker: Mi'kael
segments.say: on the green front, fair play to them, they've got their own house in order. their offices and their labs, the lot, it's all off wind and solar and the like now. back in twenty eighteen you were looking at about a third. so credit where it's due, that's no mean feat.

segments.speaker: Rob
segments.say: now here's the kicker, folks. this wasn't some canned slide show. every last chart up there, every line of type, all that slick animation, it was getting cooked up from scratch the whole time we've been running our mouths.
